American rapper Lil Wayne has released 286 singles including 19 promotional singles.

Lil Wayne attained his first singles chart entry in 1999 as a featured artist on Hot Boys member Juvenile's single "Back That Azz Up", which peaked at number 19 on the United States Billboard Hot 100 and became a top ten hit on the Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs and Hot Rap Songs charts.
Wayne later released his debut solo studio album Tha Block Is Hot in November 1999.
